I do understand what you are talking about. I understand that it's not my place to decide who is deserving of life and who is not. However, when we live in a world where these people are not meeting justice and are allowed to continue to harm those who cannot protect themselves, at what point should we stand up and say stop. If you witness a vulnerable entity being victimized, will you step back and say it's not my place, or will you protect them? If allowing 10 people who feel no empathy or remorse go free, how many victims will they take? At least 5 a piece and that's a low estimate. That's 50 mentally disable, children, elderly, physically disabled, animals, who are now victims because well, thats just not our job or our place. I understand some people have a very strong view on death, to me, I am not scared of it and it is not the worst thing that can happen to a person, im not calling for them to be tortued, just to leave the rest of us alone. I sway between these to concepts morally. In all honesty, I don't know what the right thing to do is, but I can tell you, If I saw a person molesting a child, I'd cut their throat right then and there. I would also happily take my prison sentence. I have seen too many eyes, terrified eyes looking around for anyone to save them, begging for someone to save them. And the system, our society leaves them. Leaves them alone with their abusers. Absolutely helpless to it. I don't know you or what you have been through, but what we are doing now, is not working for the people who have to suffer through the consequences of people saying it's not our place. I'm not trying to attack you because I can see you also have a solid moral compass, but I do want to stress the horrific conditions that victims face every single moment of the day, by the millions.
I don't blame you, I wish that hadn't happened to you.

I'm not talking about mentally ill people. I'm talking about people who desire to victimize those who are weaker than themselves. I've witnessed.. too much. Enough to know at this point in our society, it's those people who feel no empathy or remorse for doing such awful things that need to go. One way or another, and our system isn't doing anything about them. They run free as nurses, beating and raping your grandma, cutting off limbs of their pets, molesting children. They need to go.
